name: VDSO Integrity
description: Cross-checks the VDSO mapping, AT_SYSINFO_EHDR, ELF load ranges, public linker ownership, and available kernel-helper symbol ownership.

evidenceUnits.title: VDSO mapping and ownership consistency
evidenceUnits.observedObject: The VDSO mapping, AT_SYSINFO_EHDR, ELF load ranges, linker owner, and available helper symbol
evidenceUnits.proposition: Available VDSO observations satisfy or violate explicit mapping and ownership consistency rules
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: procfs maps, auxv, ELF parsing, public linker enumeration, and symbol resolution
evidenceUnits.availability: Individual checks depend on readable maps and auxv plus available linker and symbol data
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The app-local channels may be mediated and are not independent kernel attestation
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A consistency violation is an anomaly and does not identify the modification mechanism
